summary.text: Heroes Among People is Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's human path killer move. Paired with Hope of the People, it amplifies Central Continent Gu Immortals and Immortal Gu Houses.

claims.text: When Chicken Dog Coop nears Emperor City, Old Man Zheng Yuan burns immortal essence as the key to activate Heavenly Court’s accumulated human will methods. After people’s united hearts and Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable’s Broken Homes and Dead Family, continent-wide Hope of the People covers Central Continent Gu Immortals in mild white light. Hope of the People and the following move are Star Constellation Immortal Venerable’s gains from exploring human path.

Old Man Zheng Yuan then activates the human path killer move Heroes Among People. The white lights shrink while Central Continent Gu Immortals’ auras grow. Fang Yuan finds Li Huang’s battle strength amplified by at least three times; the move targets the Gu Immortals themselves rather than amplifying dao marks, and it hits countless Central Continent Gu Immortals at once. Hope of the People together with Heroes Among People is treated as two rank nine killer moves used together. The effect also works on Immortal Gu Houses, because Houses are immortal killer moves in essence used by Gu Immortals. Compared with Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable’s perfect pair, which creates one clone of equal strength, Heroes Among People amplifies the main body by at least three times and in all aspects, including speed.

When Western Desert strikes Emperor City, Shen Shang fails to resolve the venerable methods and instead triggers Hope of the People and Heroes Among People in advance, buffing Central Continent’s Gu Immortals again.

After Shen Shang pours the human will of the other four regions into Central Continent, Hope of the People and Heroes Among People distinguish allies by human will, so Gu Immortals of all five regions receive amplification. Duke Long, as a dragonman variant human, cannot receive Heroes Among People; Fang Yuan’s restored human form, even from sovereign immortal fetus Gu, still counts as pure human and does receive it. A side effect is that outsiders under the four regions’ human will hate Heavenly Court more and press the attack harder.
